meta.title: Mise bundled nutrition subset
meta.reference: USDA FoodData Central (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/), SR Legacy and Foundation Foods. USDA data is in the public domain.
meta.provenance: Hand-entered on 2026-10-11 from standard reference figures for these foods, rounded to one decimal. The numbers were NOT pulled from the FDC API (no key was available) and have not been machine-checked against it, so treat them as close approximations. Run `pnpm nutrition:refresh` with USDA_API_KEY set to compare every row against FDC and overwrite it.

fields.macros: kcal, protein, carbs, fat, fiber are per 100 g of the food as described (raw or dry unless the name says otherwise).
fields.cup: Grams in one US cup (236.6 ml) of the food as usually measured. Used for every volume conversion. Missing means volume cannot be converted.
fields.units: Grams in one piece for count units: each (a medium piece), clove, slice, can (drained weight for beans and tuna), and so on. Piece weights are typical values and vary in real life.
fields.keeps: Typical days the food keeps refrigerated (pantry for onions, potatoes, garlic), loosely following USDA FoodKeeper guidance. Missing means shelf-stable. Guidance for ordering, not a safety guarantee.
fields.animal: meat (includes poultry), fish (includes shellfish), dairy, egg, or honey. Used for the diet check.
fields.staple: Things most kitchens already have. The grocery list asks you to check them instead of telling you to buy them.
fields.fdc: The FoodData Central description used as the search query by the refresh script.
